title: Using these to protect my eyes from the virus
text:
Using these to protect my eyes from the virus. I like how these glasses cover all sides of my eyes. It works well for cutting onions, but definitely gives me a sense of security when working in hospital and taking care of patients. These are better than a splash guard or the laboratory googles. Also looks stylish.

Update: after using this for 2 weeks, I noticed they get very foggy. Not recommended to be used with a mask bc it will fog up. However for onion cutting it may be fine.
